author: voidloop
body:
Hey, So today im here to suggest something. On the Overcast Network, A minecraft PvP server, there is a separated server in which teams can practice for tourneys, do scrimms and stuff like that.

What Would this bring to the community?
It would bring More teams, And the AVN would be much more popular. Nowadays AVN teams dont scrimm because they dont have a server.

What Im suggesting?
What Im suggesting is to make a separated server with some of the most frequently played maps(i.e JusticeI) And more to make the community much bigger and much more popular.

The difficulty of this:
Well obviously this would take time, but there is people like me which want to help out on this Proyect, like me and some of my friends, And don´t look for anything in particular(i.e Staff ranks) Just the satisfaction of a happier community

IMPORTANT: If this gets accepted, I suggest that the only teams which should have a server for themselves are the ones which participate in AVN tourneys.

Confusion?: Inside this server, at least in OCN they do it that way, you put: /Server TheNameOfYourTeam, And if someone has whitelisted you in there or so, You´ll go inside it and you´ll start playing. 

PLEASE READ THIS: I know that it would be a lot of HardWork for the Map Developers doing YML´s And stuff like that. But, As I said before, a LOT of people would like to help.

Thanks for taking your time here,

IStrafeer_
